label: VALIDATION_FAMILY_FOUND
prefLabel: Validation dwc:family Found
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Does the value of dwc:family occur at the rank of Family in the bdqval:sourceAuthority? It returns: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:family is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:family is found as a value at the rank of Family in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy. Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:sourceAuthority.
description: Does the value of dwc:family occur at the rank of Family in the bdqval:sourceAuthority?
notes: The purpose of this Test is to check whether the value is a name that is a result of a nomenclatural act at this rank. This excludes unpublished names, misspellings and vernacular names. It is expected that the Test will designate the source authority against which to check. The same Test might return distinct results when using distinct source authorities. **Review Note: GBIF has indicated that we should switch to the Catalog of Life for the default source authority for this test. That change is planned prior to ratification.**
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:family is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:family is found as a value at the rank of Family in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT

label: VALIDATION_MINELEVATION_INRANGE
prefLabel: Validation dwc:minimumElevationInMeters In Range
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Is the value of dwc:minimumElevationInMeters within the Parameter range? It returns: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:minimumElevationInMeters is bdqval:Empty or the value is not a number; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:minimumElevationInMeters is within the range of bdqval:minimumValidElevationInMeters to bdqval:maximumValidElevationInMeters inclusive; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: -430. Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:minimumValidElevationInMeters,bdqval:maximumValidElevationInMeters.
description: Is the value of dwc:minimumElevationInMeters within the Parameter range?
notes: We have rounded up the Parameter values. We are aware of sub-ice elevations in Antarctica to -3,500m and possible sampling in the atmosphere above the elevation of the top of Mt Everest should fail this Test if captured as elevation rather than as distanceAboveSurfaceInMeters. Elevations below the maximum elevation yet above the local surface will be false positives.
expectedResponse: INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:minimumElevationInMeters is bdqval:Empty or the value is not a number; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:minimumElevationInMeters is within the range of bdqval:minimumValidElevationInMeters to bdqval:maximumValidElevationInMeters inclusive; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
